text: Automatically captures detailed diagnostics for every error occurrence: full stack trace, method and class names, OS, device, browser, location, and host
quote: Raygun automatically captures detailed diagnostics for each and every error occurrence including full stack traces, method/function and class name data, OS, device, browser, location, host

text: Native repository integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab, with source map decoding support
quote: Connect to your repo through native integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab, with support for source map decoding.

text: Order and prioritize errors by number of users affected and number of occurrences
quote: Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.

text: Smart filters segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags
quote: Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.

text: AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them
quote: Resolve issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy using AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them.

text: Automatically prompts your chosen LLM with error context from the stack trace, environment, and affected code to get fixes
quote: Auto-prompt your chosen LLM with crucial error context from your stack trace, environment, and affected code to get fast and accurate solutions.

text: One-click AI error analysis powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI
quote: This feature allows you to identify and tackle errors swiftly with just a click, using advanced AI technology powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.

text: Collaborative AI chat on errors, with typing indicators showing which teammates are typing
quote: You can chat with this tool collaboratively. Typing indicators are shown whenever teammates are typing, so it's always clear who is using the chat.

text: Post a link to an AI chat conversation into the error's comments section
quote: Simply press the comment button in the AI chat, and it will create a link back to your conversation to be posted into the comments section.

text: Bring your own OpenAI API key and choose the GPT model used for AI features
quote: Enter your OpenAI API key and select your preferred GPT model (GPT-4 is default).

text: Groups errors by exception type, class name, method name, and location within the stack trace
quote: Raygun groups errors based on the `exception type`, `class name`, `method name`, and the location within the `stack trace`.

text: Check and select the grouping hasher version in application settings
quote: You can check which hasher version is being used in the application settings, and it's recommended to always use the latest version

text: External access tokens authenticate the Deployments API and the symbol, mapping, and JS file upload services
quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files, Uploading JavaScript files directly to Raygun

text: Upload dSYMs and ProGuard mapping files to Raygun
quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files

text: Track every deployment in real time to spot new errors or regressions
quote: Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.

text: Export all error groups or selected error groups from the Crash Reporting dashboard
quote: The Raygun Crash Reporting export feature allows customers to export all error groups or selected errors groups from within the Crash Reporting dashboard.

text: Export all data within a specific time range
quote: You can also select to export all data within a specific time range.

text: CSV exports match the applied top-level filters, such as pages, tags, and country codes
quote: Aligned **CSV exports** with applied top-level filters. Exported data now matches filtered views for: Most Requested Pages, Tags, Country codes, Other top-level filters

text: Mark fixed errors as Resolved
quote: Once you've fixed a particular error, you can mark an it as 'Resolved'.

text: Error statuses provide a workflow for triaging and managing the error inbox
quote: Error statuses provides a workflow for triaging and managing your error inbox in Crash Reporting.

text: Ignore error groups for a set time period, for a number of occurrences, or by rule
quote: We provide three types of conditions: Ignore for a specific time period ... Ignore for a specific number of occurrences ... Ignore by rule

text: Bulk-change the status of multiple selected error groups at once
quote: Select error group/s by clicking the checkbox in the list. Click the 'Change Status' dropdown that appears at the top of the list.

text: Filter sensitive data such as credit card details out of error payloads before they are sent
quote: You can filter out sensitive information from error data, meaning before errors are sent to Raygun. This enables you to remove sensitive data such as credit card details when sending errors from your application.

text: Disable storage of IP addresses via an application setting
quote: To stop the storage of IP addresses you can go to your "Application settings" page in Raygun and then enabling the "Disable IP address storage" flag.

text: Automatically fetches publicly available source maps from your website
quote: If your source maps are publicly available on your website Raygun will fetch them automatically without you having to do anything.

text: Manually upload source maps through the JS source map center or via API
quote: If the automatic option does not work for your application you can also manually upload source maps either through our website using the `JS source map center` or via our API

text: Source maps make minified JavaScript errors readable and add code snippets from your source
quote: Raygun uses them to take un-readable errors generated from minified JavaScript and translate them to be readable and to include code snippets from your source.

text: Set an auth key that Raygun sends when requesting source maps, so your server can validate the request
quote: you can setup an auth key in the JS source map center that will be sent by Raygun when requesting source maps that you can validate on your server

text: Send APM trace messages to a chosen Slack channel
quote: Select the Slack channel you would like APM trace messages to be sent to and click "Authorize".

text: Alert rules can create PagerDuty incidents that notify your incident team
quote: Now when an issue is triggered from this rule, a PagerDuty incident will be created and your incident team will be notified by PagerDuty.

text: Custom alerts via email, Slack, or Microsoft Teams
quote: Alerts via email, Slack or Teams. Get custom alerts to where your team already works

text: Spike protection detects and flags irregular data volumes to avoid surprise usage
quote: Spike protection. Detect and flag irregular data volumes to avoid any surprise usage

text: Error chart on the search results page shows error frequency and trends
quote: Added **error chart** visualization to **search results page**. Provides visual insight into error frequency and trends.

text: Visual timeline of server-side timing information for performance diagnosis
quote: Developers can identify problems more quickly, enjoying a visual timeline of server-side timing information.

text: Integrated error, crash, and performance monitoring in one place for the whole team
quote: Raygun provides a fully integrated error, crash and performance monitoring solution, unlike anything else on the market today. See everything in one place, with your entire team, and break down the walls between your monitoring tools.

text: Real User Monitoring automatically identifies front-end performance issues that cause slow page loads
quote: Real User Monitoring will automatically identify front end performance issues causing slow page load speeds. You'll be able to see what your users see in the browser and discover why users had poor quality experiences.

text: .NET client SendInBackground queues messages to prevent SNAT exhaustion in Azure environments
quote: Enhanced SendInBackground to queue messages for sending: Prevents SNAT exhaustion in .NET Core Azure environments.
